name: stockflow-full
description: The full end-to-end StockFlow capture (run 17): two sprints on one project, BOTH shipped through the complete lifecycle (design + build + deploy + promote/merge to staging), recorded with the current instrumentation (full-fidelity turn recorder + tool markers, the 3-beat kickoff round-trip, and correspondence.jsonl of the orchestrator<->Human-Proxy exchange). Sprint 1 ships F1 stock-visibility (additive: record-stock form + stock-by-location home + SKU detail). Sprint 2 ships F6 split-tracking-code as a THREE-story expand/contract refactor on live data: S1 add batch_number/serial_number + backfill, S2 drop the combined inventory_code column, S3 expose batch/serial in the read UI. 171 recorded turns; the intake owns its bytes under intake/ (product-overview, nfrs, design-brief, warehouse icon). A contiguous, end-to-end regression corpus spanning planning, design, build, deploy, and promotion for a multi-story schema refactor.

features.summary: additive: record-stock form + stock-by-location home table + SKU detail view
expand/contract refactor (3 stories): add batch_number+serial_number + backfill (S1), drop the combined inventory_code column (S2), expose batch/serial in the read UI (S3)
